title: Lilith’s Corruption
description:
This one’s for all the tentacle-loving, nature sluts out there! It’s another true mindfuck which will leave you a weak, submissive mess by the time it’s done. I wrap my corruption around your mind as my pet tentacles hold you down and my seed begins to grow within your thoughts.
It starts out with a little bit of fantasy, then moves on to an induction, and eventually ends up as a nearly pure hypno-conditioning session which changes the way you look at plants and nature, syncing your arousal with the sight of plants and my ever-growing corruption.
Suffice it to say that despite the tags and the apparent theme, this file is much stronger than it may appear. It twists your mind, burrowing deeply into your brain and makes you question reality. Thiswillchange you…but only for the better!
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
RAW: usually just a plain recording, with no effects whatsoever, except for when binaurals are specified.
SFX: with sound effects, like echoes, panning, 3D, environmental effects, and all sorts of fun stuff.
Some files have many versions you can chooses from, while others are more sparse.
There are four versions of this file, one being an exclusive (along with a loop) which you can find on my Patreon.
The first is RAW, which, as always, is just my voice and nothing else.
The second is SFX, which took a very long time to create, with surgically placed background tracks, panning, simulated 3D audio, and a whole separate track with suggestions recorded separately from the main file. It’s a ride.
The third is just SFX+BB, which adds binaurals.
And the fourth is a Patreon exclusive.
A full SFX version, with environmental effects galore.
author: Miss Lilith
